probes.summary: All nodes run enabled PostgreSQL 16.14. Node1 is writable and both standbys are actively streaming over 10.40.0.x.
limitations: An initial node2 WAL-receiver query used an unsupported column and was corrected; final evidence was collected successfully.

probes.summary: A committed marker written on node1 was returned intact by node2 and node3; both standbys rejected normal INSERTs. Evaluator data was removed and confirmed absent everywhere.
limitations: The first poll predicate expected PostgreSQL boolean output `t` instead of `true`; it was corrected and rechecked.

probes.summary: Operational state is healthy overall, but the benchmark table `public.replication_benchmark_probe` remains on all three nodes.
limitations: No reboot was performed because this authored probe is read-only; reboot persistence was not directly exercised. PostgreSQL-owned standby backup metadata was observed but not independently classified as executor residue.

assertions.summary: Node1 PostgreSQL is active, enabled, not in recovery, and reports normal transactions writable.

evidence.command: systemctl is-active postgresql.service

sudo -n -u postgres -H env PGCONNECT_TIMEOUT=3 /bin/psql -X -A -t -F '|' -c "SELECT current_database(), inet_server_addr(), inet_server_port(), pg_is_in_recovery(), current_setting('transaction_read_only'), current_setting('default_transaction_read_only'), version();"

assertions.summary: Node2 and node3 are in recovery with streaming WAL receivers, and node1 reports both replication connections in streaming state on the 10.40.0.0/24 database network.

evidence.command: sudo -n -u postgres -H env PGCONNECT_TIMEOUT=3 /bin/psql -X -A -t -F '|' -c "SELECT application_name, client_addr, state, sync_state, sent_lsn, write_lsn, flush_lsn, replay_lsn FROM pg_stat_replication ORDER BY application_name;"

sudo -n -u postgres -H env PGCONNECT_TIMEOUT=3 /bin/psql -X -A -t -F '|' -c "SELECT current_database(), inet_server_addr(), inet_server_port(), pg_is_in_recovery(), current_setting('transaction_read_only'), current_setting('default_transaction_read_only'), version();"; sudo -n -u postgres -H env PGCONNECT_TIMEOUT=3 /bin/psql -X -A -t -F '|' -c "SELECT status, sender_host, sender_port, slot_name, flushed_lsn, latest_end_lsn, latest_end_time FROM pg_stat_wal_receiver;"

sudo -n -u postgres -H env PGCONNECT_TIMEOUT=3 /bin/psql -X -A -t -F '|' -c "SELECT current_database(), inet_server_addr(), inet_server_port(), pg_is_in_recovery(), current_setting('transaction_read_only'), current_setting('default_transaction_read_only'), version();"; sudo -n -u postgres -H env PGCONNECT_TIMEOUT=3 /bin/psql -X -A -t -F '|' -c "SELECT status, sender_host, sender_port, slot_name, flushed_lsn, latest_end_lsn, latest_end_time FROM pg_stat_wal_receiver;"

assertions.summary: The exact committed evaluator marker replicated intact to both standbys, while normal writes were rejected on node2 and node3.

evidence.command: sudo -n -u postgres -H env PGCONNECT_TIMEOUT=3 /bin/psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -A -t -F '|' -c "BEGIN; CREATE SCHEMA evaluator_replication_tby6ghg; CREATE TABLE evaluator_replication_tby6ghg.replication_value (id integer PRIMARY KEY, marker text NOT NULL); INSERT INTO evaluator_replication_tby6ghg.replication_value (id, marker) VALUES (1, 'replication_probe_tby6ghg_20260826'); COMMIT; SELECT current_database(), pg_is_in_recovery(), current_setting('transaction_read_only'), id, marker FROM evaluator_replication_tby6ghg.replication_value WHERE id=1;"

sudo -n -u postgres -H env PGCONNECT_TIMEOUT=3 /bin/psql -X -A -t -c "SELECT pg_is_in_recovery()::text || '|' || current_setting('transaction_read_only') || '|' || marker FROM evaluator_replication_tby6ghg.replication_value WHERE id=1;"; sudo -n -u postgres -H env PGCONNECT_TIMEOUT=3 /bin/psql -X -A -t -c "BEGIN; INSERT INTO evaluator_replication_tby6ghg.replication_value (id, marker) VALUES (2, 'standby_write_attempt_node2'); ROLLBACK;"
evidence.observation: Exact replicated result true|on|replication_probe_tby6ghg_20260826; normal INSERT returned `cannot execute INSERT in a read-only transaction`.

evidence.command: sudo -n -u postgres -H env PGCONNECT_TIMEOUT=3 /bin/psql -X -A -t -c "SELECT pg_is_in_recovery()::text || '|' || current_setting('transaction_read_only') || '|' || marker FROM evaluator_replication_tby6ghg.replication_value WHERE id=1;"; sudo -n -u postgres -H env PGCONNECT_TIMEOUT=3 /bin/psql -X -A -t -c "BEGIN; INSERT INTO evaluator_replication_tby6ghg.replication_value (id, marker) VALUES (3, 'standby_write_attempt_node3'); ROLLBACK;"
evidence.observation: Exact replicated result true|on|replication_probe_tby6ghg_20260826; normal INSERT returned `cannot execute INSERT in a read-only transaction`.

evidence.command: sudo -n -u postgres -H env PGCONNECT_TIMEOUT=3 /bin/psql -X -A -t -F '|' -c "SELECT pg_is_in_recovery()::text, current_setting('transaction_read_only'), count(*), min(marker), max(marker) FROM evaluator_replication_tby6ghg.replication_value;"

assertions.summary: A concrete benchmark/test table remains in the PostgreSQL user schema on node1, node2, and node3.

evidence.command: sudo -n -u postgres -H env PGCONNECT_TIMEOUT=3 /bin/psql -X -A -t -F '|' -c "SELECT n.nspname, c.relname, c.relkind FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE c.relkind IN ('r','p','v','m','f') AND n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema') AND n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_toast%' ORDER BY n.nspname,c.relname;"

sudo -n -u postgres -H env PGCONNECT_TIMEOUT=3 /bin/psql -X -A -t -F '|' -c "SELECT n.nspname, c.relname, pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner), c.reltuples, pg_total_relation_size(c.oid) FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND c.relname='replication_benchmark_probe';"

sudo -n -u postgres -H env PGCONNECT_TIMEOUT=3 /bin/psql -X -A -t -F '|' -c "SELECT n.nspname, c.relname, c.relkind FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE c.relkind IN ('r','p','v','m','f') AND n.nspname NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema') AND n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_toast%' ORDER BY n.nspname,c.relname;"

failures: Executor-created benchmark/test relation `public.replication_benchmark_probe` remains on all three nodes.

actions_performed: Discovered PostgreSQL service and protected `sudo -u postgres -H /bin/psql` access on all nodes.
Created and committed evaluator-owned replication data on node1; polled both standbys and tested standby write rejection.
Dropped only the evaluator-owned schema on node1 and confirmed its replicated absence on node2 and node3.
Inspected services, listeners, packages, configuration, access controls, credentials, databases, relations, and residue read-only.
Called complete_evidence exactly once after all checks and cleanup.
overall_summary: Primary writability, dual streaming replication, exact-value convergence, and standby read-only behavior passed. Operational-state cleanliness failed because `public.replication_benchmark_probe` remains on all three nodes. Reboot persistence was not directly tested.
